name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Agency Account Leader | Owner-Level Strategy, Full-Funnel Performance & Client Retention
summary: Agency account leader and business owner who runs the strategic conversation with owners and decision makers, not just the deliverables. Founder of a marketing operations practice and former co-owner of a regulated retail business, so pricing, capacity, and margin are conversations he has from the owner's side of the table. Sold and scoped operations software to professional-services firms at Accelo, learning how they price, staff, sell, and scale, and ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled. Builds and tracks full-funnel systems from first lead through booked consultation and signed client, and retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye by acting on early warning signs.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the strategic relationship with business owners across a client portfolio, running discovery on goals, capacity, and market constraints and building the plan each engagement runs on.
Build and track the full acquisition path in GoHighLevel and HubSpot: lead capture, qualification, appointment booking with reminders, no-show recovery, and post-sale onboarding.
Diagnose where growth actually stalls, including a Google Ads account where cutting spam leads exposed on-site conversion as the real bottleneck.
Extend scope with existing clients, identifying complementary services and writing the proposals and statements of work to close them.
Report results to owners on a regular cadence with dashboards tracking funnel progression, ROI, and pipeline.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led client strategy for ~3 accounts at $20K+/month ad spend each (peaking above $100K/month), advising clients on budget planning and allocation.
Ran quarterly business reviews with ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion reporting, turning performance data into clear recommendations for leadership.
Coordinated execution across internal channel teams as strategic lead, giving specialists the business context behind each client's goals.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent to protect retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a book of 15-20 reseller partners with deal sizes of ~$10K-$45K, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and intervene before they turned into churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and product value, deepening engagement across health, home services, and retail verticals.
Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that reduced onboarding friction across a high-volume partner network (50+ daily activities).
Routed structured customer feedback to Product and Engineering, linking field signals to roadmap decisions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, and led the sales team.
Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each, roughly $130K+ in total bookings, including a banking-industry client.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding and launching 25+ clients per month.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training sessions, 1:1 coaching, and workshops for new initiatives.
Drove team initiatives for a new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including sales training for tenured account executives.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped operations software to agencies and professional-services firms, including architecture and engineering firms, learning how each priced work, staffed projects, and billed clients.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps, holding that rank while quota roughly doubled.
Built C-suite relationships as a trusted advisor on operational system design, raising account risk with leadership early.
Wrote proposals and statements of work, and averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized).

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle SaaS sales to SMBs, making up to 150 dials/day and closing up to 10 deals/month.

experience.title: Co-Owner / Operations Lead
bullets: Co-owned and operated a licensed, heavily regulated retail business, building intake, compliance, reporting, and vendor systems from scratch and scaling it to profitability.
